An earlier revision of the Alone in a Crowd cover art. The crowd is largely the same as the final version, but Oliver is missing many of the edits later added to him; his face, hair, and elements of his clothing were replaced for the final revision, and this version is also missing the blue light on the floor around him. Some stores online use this version of the cover while selling physical copies of the album.

An earlier revision of the Alone in a Crowd cover art, more polished than the last while still having differences with Oliver's face, hair, and other things. This image was used for an earlier copy of the album that was sent to distributors for the production of vinyl copies of the album. Because of this, certain early pressings of the album on vinyl use this cover, and contain earlier mixes of some songs. Some retailers use this image online when selling physical copies of the album.
